test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 26 Oct, 2023)
subject: general
question: Why is steel often called the backbone of modern industry?

options.text: Steel is used in almost every tool and machinery.
Steel can be added with any material.
It is easy to make steel alloys.

solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. Steel is used in almost every tool and machinery.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** passage mentions** that almost everything we use is either made of iron or steel or has been made with tools and machinery of these metals.
 
• **It highlights** the extensive use of steel in transportation (ships, trains, trucks, and autos), household items (safety pins and needles), industrial applications (oil wells and steel machinery), mining, farming (farm machines), and construction (large buildings).
 
• This** extensive application of steel **across various industries justifies why it’s considered the backbone of modern industry.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is '*Steel is used in almost every tool and machinery.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2**: Steel can be added with any material. This statement is incorrect as the passage talks about the creation of steel alloys by adding small amounts of specific metals, not any material.
 
• **Option 3**: It is easy to make steel alloys. While making alloys might be an important aspect, it is not the main reason steel is considered the backbone of modern industry.
 
• **Option 4:** Steel is tough. Although steel's toughness is a key property, it is not the sole reason for it being termed as the backbone of modern industry.
